title: Taylor's Glessner photograph gets a better-fitting camera
items: Nothing you can see changed in the town. The camera that lines our model of the Glessner house up with J. W. Taylor's photograph from the late 1880s has been re-solved. It now fits all three chimneys as well as the windows, and the leaning edges in the photograph set its tilt. Through it, the south and middle chimneys match the photograph's widths. The chimney over the 18th Street gable reads wider than the photograph, and that is the next thing to look at.
